title: Gherkin: strongest-available provider; Git-only remains fully functional
description:
## Behavior to specify

A worker asks Kanbus to claim a resource. Kanbus uses the strongest configured provider:

- Git only → functional distributed Kanbus (soft lease, Git latency)
- Git + MQTT → faster coordination + soft leases
- Git + MQTT + Mutex API → fast coordination + hard mutual exclusion

Missing MQTT or Mutex API is not an error and must not change Git-only business logic. A deployment without those extras is legitimate.

## Acceptance

Gherkin covers provider selection, explicit empty/disabled config, and fail-closed vs degrade behavior. Dual-runtime later.
right_now_summary: The team is defining Gherkin scenarios for provider selection while keeping Git-only operation fully functional.
